reviewer: author, direct inspection of all five actual UE PNG files using view_image

observations.overview: Exact specified orthographic composition, full site visible, upright trees. Water reflection appears bright at this angle; retained as the honest standardized view.
observations.top_down: Exact top-down orthographic square site; separate turquoise inland lake and coastal water, path and forest readable.
observations.lake: Actual 170cm eye-height lake view; water, reeds, rounded rocks and trees visible without editor UI.
observations.beach: Actual 170cm eye-height beach view; sand, distinct coastal water, foam ribbons, forest and driftwood visible without editor UI.
observations.hero: Additional perspective overview from coastal side; complete environment and both water bodies readable.

limitations: Standard overview has bright specular water reflections.
The exact 100m site terminates at a visible edge; no surrounding world is authored.
